edit_file_search_replace: edit a file by providing a search block and replacement block using SEARCH/REPLACE format
find_all_occurrences: find all occurrences of a substring in a text string and return their indices
parse_edit_command: parse an edit command with path, search text, and replacement text using SEARCH/REPLACE regex
apply_inplace_file_edit: apply an in-place file edit by replacing search text with replacement text and writing back
validate_edit_uniqueness: validate that search text appears exactly once in a file before performing replacement
